blocks.text: After unboxing our early access to the iPhone 18 Pro Max, we were able to make some conclusions.
Are you looking for a better camera?

If your answer is yes then know that Apple has completely re-engineered the main camera of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max with a variable aperture. If you zoom in on the main lens you can actually see the opening move to adjust how much light comes in. You can go from the widest f/1.48 for very low light areas to f/4.0 for wider shots.
Are you a professional creative who needs to secure copyright?

If you are a creative professional, Apple has also introduced Reference Image on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. Whenever you take a photo, your phone stamps a cryptographic identifier to the photo which is like the equivalent of a digital negative. This is useful in the age of AI and social media where one needs to prove that an image was taken by the original creator and prove copyright.
Are you looking to use this without a case?

Although it may look very similar on the outside, the new Pro and Pro Max have a different layout on the vapor chamber where the A20 chip and RAM are not sandwiched on top of one another, but placed side by side. This allows for better cooling in the vapor chamber. Previous models would heat up by the camera plateau but this has been vastly improved – yes there’s still heat build up but significantly less now. That means you can use the new iPhones with those minimalist case brackets.

blocks.caption: iPhone 18 Pro Max Unit in Silver

blocks.text: That being said, the new iPhone 18 Pro Max has the exact same button configuration as the previous model which means your old cases will work fine!

If money is no object and you’re willing to upgrade anyway, you can always give your old iPhone to your child. That also means that for parents, iOS 27 has completely revamped the parental controls onboarding, making it easier to monitor your kid’s Internet behavior on iOS or iPad OS. Simply reset your old phone, say you’re setting up the iPhone for your child, and follow the on-screen instructions.

Other than improved battery life if you find these reasons compelling enough to get you to upgrade, the new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are launching at midnight with many store promos from official stores so you don’t get scammed!
